howto.title: How to connect Stellarium
howto.step1: Plugins → Telescope Control → enable the plugin → configure
howto.step3: Telescope controlled by: <mono>3rd party software or remote computer</mono>
howto.step6: Save and connect. The telescope reticle should appear on the sky.
howto.step7: In telescope properties, set <hl>Coordinate system: J2000</hl> (this is the default).
howto.footer: Right-click any object → Current object → Slew telescope to issue a GoTo. Position is pushed to Stellarium every 500 ms.

manifest.name: Stellarium Server
manifest.description: Stellarium telescope server, watch the mount's position from Stellarium
